compare_countries.description: Put two to fifty countries side by side on one indicator and rank them, in a single step. description: Read the World Bank's open development data with no account or API key: GDP, population, inflation, life expectancy, poverty and more than 28,000 other indicators for over 200 economies and their regional and income groups, from the World Development Indicators and the World Bank's other databases, plus poverty and inequality estimates from its Poverty and Inequality Platform.
